title: Dr Frost Arctic Strawberry Coconut Ice Cream 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Dr Frost Arctic Shortfill Strawberry Coconut Ice Cream combines the luscious sweetness of ripe Strawberries with the smooth, creamy taste of Coconut Ice Cream, finished with a refreshing menthol exhale. This indulgent yet refreshing e-liquid offers a delightful balance of dessert and cool fruit flavours, making it ideal for vapers seeking something bold and unique. As part of Dr Frost’s Arctic Edition collection, this shortfill features double-concentrated ‘Bar Salts’ flavour, delivering the intense taste associated with disposable vapes. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, it’s designed for use with low-powered Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) pod kits. The 100ml bottle leaves space for two 10ml nicotine shots, offering flexibility to customise nicotine strength or enjoy it nicotine-free. Dr Frost Arctic Shortfills are a versatile and economical choice for adult smokers and vapers seeking bold flavours and exceptional value.
